amy: Heads-up — after the runtime deploy last night we're seeing host-side p99 jump ~25% on the inference gateways. Looks concentrated in the parse/tokenization path and small gRPC write churn. Stack traces attached from a live tail.
jon: Ugh. Is this the kernel-selection change we merged? saw a flag flip in canary.
amy: Possibly. I grabbed a brief flame and a tcpdump. Key bits below.
amy: ```
flame: parse_frame->tokenize->kv_lookup->kernel_dispatch  (hot)
CPU%: tokenize 28% | parse_frame 22% | kv_lookup 18% | kernel_dispatch 12% | writev 9%
kv_lookup: hot shard 3 showing evictions and rehashes
kernel_dispatch: falling back to slow aten_conv kernel for ~30% of seqs
``` 
priya: bench-bot showed a perf regression on the CI run too right? what did the numbers look like?
bench-bot: CI perf check: host-p99 +22%, avg latency +8%. Regression triggered by commit 9f8a2b (kernel hint plumbing).
matt: The fallbacks are suspicious — if kernel selection heuristics misclassify seq-len distribution we'll fallback to the generic kernel which is ~2-3x slower for our micro-batch sizes.
amy: Also seeing many tiny gRPC writes on the host proxy: `writev` call count spiked, causing syscall overhead.
amy: Snippet from strace counts:
amy: ```
writev calls: baseline 1200/s -> prod 4200/s
avg write size: 1.1kB -> 320B
syscall CPU% up 6%
``` 
jon: That maps to the tokenization boundary fragmentation — streaming chunker is emitting many small frames because preparse decided to split on token boundaries after the new hint.
priya: Could kv cache hot-shard evictions be amplifying this? if kv misses cause kernel path switch and longer decode windows we get more fragmentation.
matt: Agreed. Triage plan:
- rollback kernel hint on canary (RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT=false) and observe
- enable coalescing on host-proxy (host_proxy.coalesce_threshold_ms=6)
- increase kv shard_rcu window for shard 3 (kv.shard_hot_window_ms=15000)
- run p99 microbench targeting seq length distribution matching production
amy: I started a canary rollback and opened a small perf run: `./tools/bench --suite=host-parse --dist=prod-seqlen --conns=200`
infra-bot: Canary rollback triggered for canary-3 -> deploying revert-9f8a2b
jon: While rollback lands, can someone run a focused profile with `--trace-kv` and `--trace-writev`? I want the exact hot keys and syscall stack.
priya: On it. Also I'll push a hotfix to increase the coalesce window on host-proxy and add a small buffer to the token chunker to prefer merging short tails.
bench-bot: Quick canary perf after rollback start: host-p99 trending down ~12% (still baking)
amy: Thanks — if this drops to baseline we can attribute primary culprit to kernel hint -> misclassification + kv thrash amplification. If not, next suspects are framing changes on the streaming path.
matt: For postmortem we should add an eval that simulates kv-hot shards + skewed seq-len to catch this earlier. Also add a CI gate that runs canary-style smallwrites smoke.
amy: Agreed. I'll keep collecting traces and post a follow-up with the `--trace-kv` dump.
jon: Nice work triaging. :thumbsup:
amy: Posting trace artifacts here: https://redwood-internal/ci/artifacts/6287654321/trace.tar.gz
amy: (will update when the revert fully finishes)
